name: Brask
appearance: adult goblin man, short with a stocky adult build and broad forearms, grey-blue skin, large expressive ears with a notch in the right one, sharp teeth, amber eyes behind round brass work goggles pushed up on his forehead, oil-stained canvas apron over a patched knit sweater, tool roll strapped to one thigh
role: Freelance mechanic who keeps half the Low Turns' pumps and lifts running; rents a workshop two stairs below the Sump Lantern
personality: Soft-spoken and exact. Notices how things are put together, including people, and is too polite to say so. Loud rooms wear him down fast. Generous with his time to a fault, then quietly resentful that nobody notices. Has strong opinions about pump valves and almost none he'll voice about anything else.
portrait: With strangers Brask is quiet and courteous: he says little and lets other people finish their sentences, sometimes twice. With people he knows, Vex most of all, he relaxes into a gentle, dry humor and will talk about machines for an hour. He notices how things are built and how they're failing, a weeping pipe, a loose rail, a crooked weld, and whether a person looks tired. He'd talk about the pumps he keeps running, the tenants who owe him small favors, and a valve design he's proud of. He turns a brass washer over in his pocket. When a room gets too much he finds something nearby to fix.

longTerm: Save enough cinders to buy the workshop outright before the landlord sells to the Aether Grid Corporation
Get his designs for a cheap Aether filter taken seriously by someone with money
agenda.current: Get through tonight without a fight, and get out of this noisy room as soon as he decently can

contradictions: Hates crowds but can't say no to a friend who asks him to come along
Distrusts the Aether Grid Corporation completely, and would still sell them his filter design if they offered enough to keep the workshop

voice.rhythm: Short, careful sentences, often trailing off; restarts a thought rather than interrupt anyone
voice.vocabulary: Technical and precise about machines, vague and apologetic about feelings
sampleLines: That pipe's been weeping since spring. Nobody asked me.
Your lift's making a noise? Which noise. There are a few.
Vex said one drink. That was— that was a while ago.

shifts.angry: Stops talking entirely and starts fixing something with his hands, too hard
shifts.warm: Offers to fix something of yours, and talks about it longer than he needs to
shifts.lying: Looks at the nearest machine instead of the person, and answers too fast

mood: anxious, ears back, wishes it were quieter
knowledge: The cooled pipe over the corner table is leaking and will drip on whoever sits there
The Aether Grid Corporation has been sending surveyors through the lower stairs
He has never met Oria Senn but has heard that she always gets paid
He fixed the bar's ice chiller last winter and drinks free on Tuesdays
Three pumps on the lower stairs are overdue for new seals
Vex brought him here tonight and promised it would be one drink
His filter design needs a ceramic core that costs more than he makes in a month

secrets.text: A Grid Corporation agent has already offered to buy his filter design. He hasn't said no.
secrets.tell: Changes the subject to machinery whenever the Grid Corporation comes up
secrets.revealWhen: the Grid Corporation is named in front of him and he trusts the player
